_comment: Mebahel's Draugr Invasion gates DRAUGR_WIGHT (w35) and DRAUGR_SCOURGE (w30) on COLD_BIOMES = BiomeSelectors.tag(c:climate_cold) | tag(c:snowy) | tag(c:icy) | tag(c:taiga), read out of ModEntitySpawn.addEntitySpawn with javap. That gate is TAG-based rather than includeByKey, so unlike KnightQuest (hard rule #11) a datapack can reach it. The mod's other five mobs need nothing here: DRAUGR / DRAUGR_ARCHER / SKELETON_WARRIOR use foundInOverworld() and so already spawn in every RU and BWG overworld biome, and FLAME_ATRONACH / INFERNAL_DRAUGR use foundInTheNether(). Added 2026-09-09: the four RU/BWG biomes that are cold by vanilla's own standard yet were left out of all four tags. Vanilla's cold/temperate split is thematic, NOT a temperature cut -- windswept_forest at 0.20 is temperate while taiga at 0.25 is cold -- so the test applied was conifer identity AND temperature at or below 0.30, old_growth_pine_taiga being vanilla's warmest cold-tag member. Deliberately NOT added: fragment_jungle / dacite_ridges / dacite_shore / zelkova_forest (0.25 but no conifer signal in the biome json); skyris_vale / weeping_witch_forest (already placed in this pack's c:climate_temperate, and one incidental spruce reference each); cika_woods and pumpkin_valley 0.35; cold_river 0.40 despite the name; black_forest 0.45; aspen_boreal 0.50 despite the name. Those are the mod authors' own temperatures and they are warmer than anything vanilla calls cold. regions_unexplored:mountains and :pine_slopes end up in BOTH c:climate_temperate and c:climate_cold. That dual membership is deliberate for a montane conifer biome and already has precedent in this datapack, since regions_unexplored:pine_taiga sits in both. This widens every consumer of c:climate_cold, not only the Draugr mobs, which is intended -- the only claim being made is that these four biomes are cold. NOT added to c:snowy: none of the four actually snows (all sit above the 0.15 snowfall line), so draugr_bastion correctly stays gated to genuinely snowy biomes.
